Six study days, then a catch-up day, seven times over, then the capstone. Every catch-up day is a Tuesday and is deliberately unallocated — if you are on track, the day is yours.

Paused after day 2 (Sat 25 Jul) and resumed at day 3 on Friday, 2 October 2026.
